entry.title: New: dsh-wxauto-plugin
entry.summary: WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4. Exact install spec: github:br1nosense/dsh-wxauto-plugin. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
